decisions.reason: Using an email invitation to add boards to the client's JLCPCB account does not change component sourceability or the existing Extended-part fee policy.
The account setup method does not change the required BOM contents or component entries.
Adding boards to a manufacturing account does not alter KiCad project portability.
The invitation-based ordering workflow does not change which sensor-board production files must be delivered.
The manufacturer account setup method has no effect on the ESP32 module or full-pin breakout requirements.
The ordering-account workflow does not change the AXP2101 power-path topology.
Adding the boards to the client's account does not modify interboard connectors, pinouts, or power distribution.
The manufacturing account setup method is unrelated to panel input mappings and mounting.
The source decision does not change the LED board's design, LED count, or selected component.
The invitation-based account workflow does not alter the main board's dimensions, orientation, or connector placement.
The manufacturing account setup method does not affect rail monitoring hardware or measurement coverage.
The ordering workflow does not change battery connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
